Specification: This module contains a PlusCal algorithm and its generated TLA+ translation for a simple two-process system that manipulates a sequence-valued variable named box. One process named appender repeatedly either appends a dependency-provided value to the sequence or skips, while another process named retriever repeatedly inspects the sequence length and removes one or two elements from the front when the sequence is long enough; it also eventually calls a simple procedure. The specification defines the initial state, translated control-state variables, the next-state relation, a standard temporal safety specification Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars, and a liveness property asserting eventual termination of all processes in the "Done" control location. The design uses the standard PlusCal translation variables pc, stack, and a procedure parameter array param, and includes a terminating stuttering action to avoid deadlock after completion. There is no explicit fault model; this is a straightforward sequential-control PlusCal model using TLC helpers and sequence operations.
